cases.title: Lung Adenocarcinoma — CT Nodule 1 (z=1482mm)
cases.primary_citation: Armato SG III, McLennan G, Bidaut L, et al. The Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI). Med Phys. 2011;38(2):915–931.
cases.secondary_citation: Clark K, Vendt B, Smith K, et al. The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA). J Digit Imaging. 2013;26(6):1045–1057.
cases.annotation_method: DICOM SEG — 4/4 radiologist independent reads; pixel-level nodule contours; union + consensus masks
cases.annotation_reference: Armato SG III, et al. Med Phys. 2011;38(2):915–931.
cases.description: CT chest from LIDC-IDRI-0078, Nodule 1. Slice at z=1481.5mm — the axial level showing the maximum cross-sectional area of this nodule. Annotations from 4/4 independent radiologist reads, provided as DICOM SEG objects.

findings.label: Nodule outline (all readers)
findings.description: Outer boundary of nodule 1 — union of all 4 reader annotations on this slice (z=1481.5mm). Pulmonary nodule — expert contour from LIDC-IDRI DICOM SEG annotations (4 independent radiologist reads). Step 1: Fleischner criteria guide management: <6mm low-risk = no follow-up; 6–8mm = CT at 6–12 months; >8mm = PET/CT, biopsy, or CT at 3 months. Spiculated margins, upper lobe location, and smoking history increase malignancy risk. Adenocarcinoma: peripheral, TTF-1+, EGFR (non-smokers) / KRAS (smokers) mutations.

findings.label: Consensus core (≥50% readers)
findings.description: Region agreed upon by ≥2 of 4 readers — high-confidence nodule core. The margin is where inter-reader variability is highest; the core has the strongest consensus. Step 1: CT density — solid (highest risk), part-solid, pure GGO (AIS).

cases.license_statement: CC BY 4.0 — NCT-CRC-HE dataset, University Medical Centre Mannheim. Cite: Kather JN et al. Zenodo. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.1214456.
cases.primary_citation: Kather JN et al. Zenodo. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.1214456.
cases.annotation_method: Expert pathologist patch classification — Adipose tissue
cases.description: Representative Adipose tissue patches from colorectal H&E (NCT-CRC dataset). Composite of 4 expert-classified 224×224px patches at 0.5µm/px.

findings.label: Adipose tissue
findings.expert_note: Tissue class: Adipose tissue. Patch-level classification label from NCT-CRC dataset (University Medical Centre Mannheim). Each 224×224px patch is manually classified by expert pathologists. CC BY 4.0.
findings.ai_explanation: Step 1: Adipose (fat) tissue = adipocytes with large clear vacuoles, peripheral nucleus. Lipoma = benign; liposarcoma = malignant. Pericolonic fat involvement = T3 staging.
